headline: An AI tool that estimates a woman's five-year breast cancer risk from a past mammogram is now sold across the US for $249.
score_reason: Consumer-facing FDA-authorized tool with expert caveats; limited evidence of benefit.
importance_line: Women who have had a screening mammogram can now buy a risk estimate, but experts say it omits family history, may cause anxiety, and has not shown better outcomes.
summary: Everyday Health reports that Clairity Breast, an FDA-authorized AI tool that predicts five-year breast cancer risk from a screening mammogram, can now be ordered nationwide through Everlywell for $249, without insurance cover. Outside experts quoted by the outlet say its single-image input leaves out family history and that it has not been shown to improve patient outcomes.
notes: Launch date not stated in text.
